title: A nested spin structure and single molecule magnet behaviour in an Fe8Dy12 heterometallic cyclic coordination cluster

synthesis.procedure: A solution of 109 mg teaH3 (1 mmol) and 100 µL Et3N in 10 mL MeCN was added dropwise to a stirred solution of 101 mg Fe(NO3)3·9H2O (0.25 mmol) and 112 mg Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.25 mmol) in 5 mL MeOH. The mixture was stirred for 10 minutes, then 80 µL Et3N was added dropwise. After another 10 minutes of stirring, the glass vial was sealed and left undisturbed. The main text states that the reaction was performed at ambient temperature. Colourless block-shaped crystals were isolated after 14 days.
synthesis.time: stirring 10 min, then 10 min after the second base addition; crystallisation for 14 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed glass vial, solution reaction followed by undisturbed crystallisation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The sealed vial was left undisturbed and colourless block-shaped crystals were isolated after 14 days.

properties.summary: Compound 1 shows dominant ferromagnetic Fe(III)–Dy(III) coupling, magnetic anisotropy, and single-molecule-magnet behaviour. AC susceptibility shows out-of-phase signals below 5 K without observable maxima, and microSQUID hysteresis at millikelvin temperatures lacks a zero-field quantum-tunnelling step. Relaxation is fitted to direct, Raman, and Orbach terms with Ueff = 3.54 K. MAGELLAN analysis divides the twelve Dy(III) easy axes into spin-ice-like, toroidal, and boat-like sets that rationalise the hysteresis shape.
